crossRefs.note: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs…
When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…

translations.web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
